_comment_: COA-gate provisioning file for the HOSTED web workbench (coa_provision.py). Web runs are built from an upload form and carry no hand-written coa_validation block, so this file supplies one per legal entity: the server injects it into each run's config keyed on the run's resolved legal entity (the paying account -> entity map), so the Phase-5 gate fires on the hosted review surface. This file and the Books COA JSON it points at are sensitive client config: they live on the Fly /data volume (NOT committed, NOT baked into the image), pointed at by the EXPENSE_RECON_COA_PROVISION env var. Env unset => no injection (existing behaviour). The org_ids below are placeholders; the real file lives in the gitignored brisken context/ and is uploaded to /data at deploy time.
